history.event: Claude refinement: 58 line(s) suggested — Corrected garbled words from images and context (mazo fagiani, salvadore, maddalena, ghonella, chalzolaio), headings with cross + ad, and figures checked against the sums (e.g. trentacinque ß xvij = ⫳ 35.17; 84 braccia at ß ij 𝒹 viij = ⫳ 11.4; ß xv = ⫳ 4.15; ß xviij = ⫳ 4.18 and 18). | layout: l1: marginal number beside l7, crossed by the paragraph stroke; l5: marginal number 87 beside l6; l13: the sum may continue past the box (a denari figure after 18 at the page edge); l15: no text, only the paragraph-mark flourish that begins l20; Kraken '5a' is a hallucination; l35, l36: fragments of the vertical marginal note (…Salvadore) beside l37–l38; '8' and '5' are not real readings; l43: empty box on a ruled dash; l48, l55, l58: only the slash/check marks in the left margin, not text; l49: the sum figure 3 is outside the box to the right; l72: 'xjº' at the left lies outside the box, and the sum continues past the right edge; most of the box covers the empty lower margin | doubts: l2: probably the year 1466; I can't tell whether the glyph after the cross and 'a' is d or M; l4, l9, l20, l21, l24: hard cursive; several words are marked [?] where I couldn't confirm the letters; l8, l26: the mark after xxij (looks like a cross or ꝉ) is unclear: ⁊ or a lira sign?; l11, l31: the trade name after the person's name (carrolaio/carolaio?) is unclear; l25/l40: the place name 'am…spiano' (split across l39/l40) is unclear, maybe Montespiano; l45: the month word looks overwritten or struck; the reading is uncertain; l54: the soldi figure is read as vj because the following sum is 6; the strokes look odd; l66: 'arcovrare' (ricovrare?) and the repeated 'sino ī sino' are uncertain; l1 vs ⫳: this manuscript has no conventions file, so I kept Kraken's ⫳ for the double-barred lira sign
